name: Park Hyatt Maldives Hadahaa
insider_take: This ultra-exclusive resort sits on a pristine private island in the untouched Huvadhoo Atoll, where you'll find some of the most pristine coral reefs in the Maldives and waters so clear you can see manta rays gliding beneath your villa.
whats_special: Park Hyatt Maldives Hadahaa is located in the Gaafu Alifu Atoll, one of the largest and deepest atolls in the world. The resort features just 50 villas, making it one of the most intimate luxury properties in the Maldives. The island sits within a UNESCO Biosphere Reserve, offering unparalleled access to untouched marine ecosystems and some of the best diving spots in the Indian Ocean.
pro_tip: Book your stay between May and November for the best manta ray encounters at nearby Manta Point, and don't miss the resort's marine biology center where you can participate in coral restoration programs.
dont_miss: The resort's overwater spa treatments at sunset, snorkeling at the house reef just steps from your villa, and the signature dining experience at The Dining Room where meals are crafted with ingredients from the resort's organic garden. The island's position also offers some of the clearest night skies in the Maldives for stargazing.
pros: Exclusive overwater and beach villas with direct ocean access
UNESCO Biosphere Reserve location with pristine coral reefs
World-class spa treatments and wellness facilities
cons: Limited dining venues on the small island
